summary: A sheet titled Switch session with a description and a list of eight accounts that close it on click.
use: Mobile account or option pickers that slide up and can be dragged down to dismiss.
spec: `<Sheet bind:open title="Switch session" description="Choose the active account">`
`const accounts` has 8 entries, Account A to Account H, rendered by `{#each accounts as acc}`
Each item is `<button class="item" onclick={() => (open = false)}>` inside `<Stack gap="1">`
Trigger is `<Button variant="outlined"` labelled Open sheet
